faq.q: Can you help before I choose a plan?
faq.a: Yes. Email support@aivideosugc.com with what you sell and the kind of ads you need. We can help you choose a plan.
We reply by email after reviewing your message. Include your account email and the issue so we can help without extra back-and-forth.

faq.q: Can support help me publish to TikTok or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Email us which platform you tried, when you tried, and what happened. We can help you find the publishing problem.

faq.q: Who do I email about an actor, captions, or my own software?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com with your account email and what you want to do. We can help with actors, captions, or software connections.

faq.q: What if a failed photo or video did not return credits?
faq.a: Failed photo and video jobs return their credits. If you still see a charge, email support@aivideosugc.com with the job time.

faq.q: What details help support find my photo or video?
faq.a: Send your account email, what happened, when it happened, and a screenshot of any error. Those details help us find the job.

faq.q: Is email the only support channel?
faq.a: Yes. Email support@aivideosugc.com from your account address. This keeps your question and our reply in one place.

faq.q: How do I reach customer service?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com to reach customer service. Include your account email and a short description so we can find your issue.
